7 انقاس It was, or became, measured by another thing like it. (S, in art. قوس; and K, in the present art.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) [It was, or became, determined, or judged of, by comparison, or analogy.] You say, هٰذِهِ مَسْئَلَةٌ لَا تَنْقَاسُ (assumed tropical:) [This is a question not to be determined, or judged of, by comparison, or analogy]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
